title: Band-score overview

display.layout: band ladder + calculation explainer + criterion accordions + raw-to-band caveat

highlights.heading: 0 to 9
highlights.text: IELTS reports scores on a band scale from 0 to 9.

highlights.heading: Four section scores
highlights.text: The reported overall band is calculated from Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking section bands.

highlights.heading: Averaging
highlights.text: The four section bands are averaged, then rounded to the nearest half band according to IELTS rules.

highlights.heading: Quarter boundary
highlights.text: An average ending in .25 is rounded upward to the next half band.

highlights.heading: Objective sections
highlights.text: Listening and Reading normally contain 40 scored questions each; exact band conversions can vary by test version.

highlights.heading: Writing weighting
highlights.text: Writing Task 2 contributes more to the Writing band than Task 1.

highlights.heading: Speaking criteria
highlights.text: Fluency/coherence, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation are each part of Speaking assessment.

highlights.heading: Not an automated grade
highlights.text: This page explains official score reporting; it does not validate scores produced by this platform.
